__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

displayMode.description: How prominently this custom_field is shown on the queried scope (`null` when the query wasn't scoped to a single `scope`). Clients promote `PROMINENT` custom_fields to the record's primary surface, e.g. the invoice detail-view toolbar.

options.description: Options for OPTION-type custom_fields. Empty list for any other value type. Resolved via dataloader so a list of N custom_fields triggers a single batched lookup.
